tagline: Fintech-focused bank partner delivering payment, deposit and lending solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Fintech fee revenue is a key driver of the company's growth, with a 21% increase in 2025 compared to 2024. This organic growth demonstrates the effectiveness of the fintech partnership strategy and the increasing monetization of the payment platform.

kpis.name: Fintech Fees
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from fintech services including referral program fees and payment services
kpis.description: Fintech fee revenue in millions of dollars

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net interest income relative to earning assets
kpis.signal: Decline of 54bps in 2025, due to portfolio mix shift toward non-interest fintech loans and lower Fed rates

kpis.name: Return on Assets
kpis.explanation: Ratio of net income to average assets, measuring profit generation efficiency
kpis.signal: Decline of 17bps in 2025 despite growth in net revenue, reflecting asset expansion

kpis.name: Average Deposits
kpis.explanation: Annual average of total deposits, a key measure of bank funding
kpis.description: Average deposits in millions of dollars
kpis.signal: 14% increase in 2025, primarily driven by fintech deposits (+970M)

kpis.name: Fintech Loans
kpis.explanation: End-of-period portfolio of sponsored fintech loans, primary strategic growth driver
kpis.description: Fintech loans in billions of dollars
kpis.signal: 142% increase in 2025, rising from $454.4M in 2024 to $1.10B, major expansion of strategic portfolio

kpis.name: Fintech Fees Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of fintech fee revenue, reflecting partnership expansion and volume growth
kpis.signal: 21% organic growth in 2025, driven by existing volumes and new product launches

kpis.name: Fintech Loans Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of the sponsored fintech loan portfolio
kpis.signal: Exceptional 142% expansion in 2025, demonstrating the success of the fintech lending strategy

ai_positioning.summary: TBBK explicitly mentions investing in AI tools to enhance the efficiency and productivity of its teams and platforms as part of its infrastructure strategy. This commitment remains limited and not central to the company's core value proposition.
evidence: We continue to invest in our infrastructure, with a focus on investing in AI tools to gain efficiency and productivity of our people and platform
